verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the SigNoz product itself. AI task delegation is documented only through external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot, which connect via the official MCP server or use published Agent Skills. The AI use-case docs (natural-language dashboard creation, alert tuning, deploy investigation) are not shown to run in-product, and external-agent access is a separate capability from a built-in assistant.
